paragraphs.text: # dsh-turnkeeper
Per-turn cost meter and tool-loop guard for the DSH web GUI. Every finished turn gets one record — m
odel time, tool time, idle time, retries, errors — and the same plugin can refuse tool calls that ar
e clearly going nowhere.
每轮耗时计量 + 运行时护栏。一轮结束写一条记录（模型/工具/空转、重试、报错），并在工具调用明显失控时直接拒绝。
## Install

- npm: `dsh plugin add dsh-turnkeeper`
- source: point **Plugins → install bundle** at a checkout of

in add dsh-turnkeeper`
- source: point **Plugins → install bundle** at a checkout of this repository
No build step, no runtime dependencies, no network calls. Node.js 22 or newer.
## What it measures
| Hook | What it counts |

| `llm/stream` | time to first chunk and total time of every model call |
| `tools/execute` | wall t

ime and outcome of every root tool call (nested calls are skipped) |
| `agent/request-error` | retri

es requested by the runtime |
| `agent/turn-stopping` | writes the turn's record to `$DSH_HOME/turnk

y the runtime |
| `agent/turn-stopping` | writes the turn's record to `$DSH_HOME/turnkeeper.jsonl` |
One record per turn: `at`, `session`, `turn`, `totalMs`, `modelMs`, `toolMs`, `otherMs`, `modelCalls
`, `toolCalls`, `retries`, `errors`, `slowest`, `blocked`, `byStep`, `byRetry`, `bySlow`, `gate`, `s
uggestion`, `adviceKind`.
## Guardrails
All three run in `tools/pre-execute` and answer `deny` with a reason the model can read and act on.
| Guard | Trigger | Effect |
| Step gate | this turn took `stepGate` root tool calls since the agent last reported progress | nex

t call denied until the agent writes a progress message |
| Retry breaker | the same tool already fa

iled `retryGate` times this turn | further calls denied; the agent must change approach |
| Slow-com
mand block | the same command prefix previously ran longer than `slowBlockMs` in the foreground | ru
nning it again is denied; the agent must background it |
A message counts as reporting progress when its text is at least 12 characters — with or without too
l calls in the same message. Only silent tool-call runs are gated.
### Dynamic step gate
By default the gate is not a constant. Every five minutes the plugin reads the last seven days of th
e ledger, takes the 80th percentile of root tool calls per turn, multiplies it by 1.4, adds 2, and c
lamps the result to 4–20. Below five samples it uses the configured `stepGate`. The line in a denial
names the limit and the basis it came from.
## Configuration
`$DSH_HOME/turnkeeper.config.json` — re-read whenever the file changes, no restart needed:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- `stepGateMode: "fixed"` pins the gate to `stepGate` and ignores the ledger.
- `stepGateWorkTurnMin
` (default 3) keeps quiet turns out of the percentile: a turn that only ran one or two tools says no
thing about how hard a real working turn is, and letting those in drags the p80 — and the gate — dow

n to nothing.
- `slowLearnMs` is the learning threshold and `slowBlockMs` the blocking threshold. Ke

ep the first below the second, or nothing is ever learned.
- `exempt` lists tools that are neither c

ounted nor denied.
- `enabled: false` keeps measuring and stops guarding.
## Tool `turn_cost`
- `{turns: 1..10}` — recent turns from memory, including the slowest tool, the denial breakdown and

one line of advice.
- `{days: 1..365}` — aggregate the on-disk ledger: active days, busiest days, to

advice.
- `{days: 1..365}` — aggregate the on-disk ledger: active days, busiest days, total denials.
## UI
- A card under each reply: the turn's split across model / tools / idle, denials, and the advice lin

e.
- A ledger view (`conversation.view`, labelled 轮次) listing past turns grouped by day, with a per-

row detail panel.
- Accepting an advice writes a 24-hour policy that the guards apply immediately —
for example a tighter step gate for `model`-heavy turns. Rejecting it mutes that advice kind for sev
ple a tighter step gate for `model`-heavy turns. Rejecting it mutes that advice kind for seven days.
Data files, all in `$DSH_HOME`:
| File | Contents |

| `turnkeeper.jsonl` | one record per finished turn |
| `turnkeeper.decisions.jsonl` | accept / reje

ct decisions with an optional note |
| `turnkeeper.policy.json` | policies currently in force (expir

n optional note |
| `turnkeeper.policy.json` | policies currently in force (expire after 24 hours) |
## Limits
- The slow-command guard learns: the first slow run of a command cannot be stopped, only remembered.
- A denial is not a retry. If the agent keeps calling without reporting, it stays denied for the re

st of the turn — deliberate, but long tasks can be pushed to finish early.
- Time is wall-clock insi
de this process; a suspended machine counts as model time.
